items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
items.creator: Rebecca Bellan

items.creator: Marina Temkin

items.title: X-energy gets green light to build its first small modular nuclear reactors
items.summary: X-energy received a construction permit from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission to build four reactors in Texas.
items.creator: Tim De Chant
